keying_notes: GREEN chroma. The shipped scripts/key-idle-clips.mjs despill is magenta-family only; a green-despill post-pass (two-branch: warm green-dominant pixels pulled to max(R,B) to keep the tan straw brown; cool green-dominant pixels neutralised to luminance-grey so the effect blooms read white, never teal) was applied to every clip before encode. Safe because nothing on this character is natively green. Specials also got a 48px edge-feather on the effect-bearing edges (sp1 right, sp2 left+right, sp3 right+top) so the contained arcs dissolve at the frame boundary instead of hard-cutting.

throw_a.notes: Solo-safe (no phantom opponent, empty reaching hand). During the grab-and-slam 'around' wrench (~f48-60) the torso rotates to a 3/4-BACK view then returns to the profile-right anchor; he never turns to FACE the camera. Anchor-locked f0==f96. Faint residual olive on the motion-blurred straw front-tuft near the reaching hand (transient).

throw_b.notes: Shoulder barge, solo-safe. Faces screen-right throughout, no back-turn. Anchor-locked.

block_a.notes: Contact is the counter-punish slash (deflect/parry is ~f10-16, not the landing blow).

block_b.notes: Contact is the rising counter cut. Brief 1-frame white steel blade-glint sparkle ~f36 (white-family, contained, keys clean).

hit.notes: Sharp whip-back recoil, stays on feet, resolves quickly to guard. Anchor-locked.

ko.notes: Begins at anchor stance, drops odachi, sinks and collapses prone on the ground and HOLDS (does NOT return to anchor, per contract). Cause-free, no opponent. cal lands the frame-0 anchor.

victory.notes: Odachi flourish + settle. During the spin flourish (~f16-20) the torso rotates to a brief 3/4-BACK view then returns to the profile-right anchor; never faces the camera. Anchor-locked.

special_1_iai_flash_cut.notes: Single decisive iai draw-cut; white steel arc at full extension. Effect contained in frame; right edge feathered 48px. One measured contact (specials guidance suggests 2-3, but the acting is a single cut - not fabricating a second).

special_2_odachi_cyclone.notes: Intended full-circle spin finisher (rotates through all facings incl. back and front - this is the designed cyclone, not a facing defect); anchor-locked f0==f96, white wind vortex contained and fully dissipated by the last frame. 3-hit string measured at the blade's forward passes. Heavy spin motion-blur: a faint OLIVE tint remains on the semi-transparent blurred straw cape edge for the fastest spin frames (residual green-screen bleed through blurred straw, neutralised from chroma-green to a plausible olive; transient, plays at 2x). left+right edges feathered 48px.

special_3_rising_crescent.notes: Single explosive rising diagonal slash; white crescent of light at the apex of the rise. Effect contained; right+top edges feathered 48px. Very faint residual mint whisper in the crescent core (sub-threshold green, marginal). One measured contact.
